uncertainty: Eight pinned native package paths passed the valid local two-track MP4 control in cpp; 12 more verified paths are needed. Four Homebrew formula-name queries saved 15 hits and 15 unique names (first 100 per query). Fuzzy name hits are leads, not parser proof. No documented lead from these surfaces remains unresolved, but projects outside them may be missing. FFmpeg, GStreamer, MediaInfoLib, VLC, MP4v2, GPAC and Bento4 have separate MP4 parser families; libmpv shares FFmpeg. VLC and Bento4 have no comparable formula install-on-request metric, so their popularity order is unresolved. The control covers one small progressive MP4 with H.264 video, AAC audio and a title; fragmented MP4 and other brands remain untested. Bento4 AP4 was built from a pinned upstream tag and its C binding parsed brand, tracks and duration. MP4Box is a GPAC alias and mp4ff is Go-only. No malformed-input, resource-use, or vulnerability experiments were run.
